depth_history.shortcut_targeted: All surviving models treat the unrestricted three-hopper conflict-assignment problem as solvable by forward exhaustive/backtracking 3-coloring within the n <= 40, 2-second limits.
depth_history.edit_summary: Add an explicit scenario requirement that the certification batch is adversarially selected from arbitrary conflict graphs at the maximum allowed size, including graphs designed to make straightforward color-by-color enumeration explore nearly its full search tree before determining feasibility or the lexicographically smallest solution.

resistant_to: Enumerates hopper colors in lexicographic order and uses recursive backtracking over ingredient indices.
Uses three-value domains and DFS propagation, but still relies on exponential backtracking for arbitrary graphs.
Attempts ordinary recursive 3-coloring in ingredient order, trying to obtain the lexicographically smallest assignment.
